title: People Ops weekly self-inventory — Amelia Rivera
content:
WEEKLY SELF-INVENTORY (working notes)
Date: 2026-03-10
Owner: Amelia Rivera
Context: quick snapshot for upcoming 1:1 — condensed evidence, asks, and micro-goals. Keep this short; bring 3 highlights + 2 asks.

1) One-line snapshot
- Focus this week: pilot manager coaching checklist + close feedback loop for hiring rubric updates. Backburner: benefits vendor negotiation.

2) Wins / evidence (concise)- Ran pilot manager coaching session (10 managers) — 85% positive on immediate usefulness (post-session quick survey).
- Updated hiring rubric draft and synced with Recruiting (Sofia) — removed ambiguous "culture" signal, replaced with two behavior anchors.
- Resolved onboarding delay for Data Science new hire (start-date risk) by coordinating with IT and People Ops ops team; new hire started on Day 1 with laptop in-hand.

Evidence snippets:
- Survey: 17 responses, NPS-ish skew toward "actionable" with 4 freeform notes (copied into my private thread).
- Jira PO-3421: moved rubric -> review -> resolved comments from two panelists.

3) Friction / blockers- Vendor negotiation: legal needs a specific data handling clause before we can finalize terms; procurement cycle unknown.
- Manager coaching: one manager asked for 1:1 follow-up because the group session surfaced a historical performance conversation — not scoped for this pilot.

4) Immediate asks for manager (pick top 2)- Approval to reroute $4k from training budget to cover an external facilitator for the next coaching series (rationale: improve uptake; 2-month payback via fewer escalations).
- Guidance on escalation: confirm my approach to support manager-level one-offs (I propose a single follow-up 30m 1:1 from People Ops, not long-term coaching).

5) Micro-goals (this week / next 7 days)- Finish vendor clause redline and send to Legal (target: Tue).
- Draft facilitator brief + sample session agenda for approval (target: Wed).
- Capture 3 anonymized quotes from the session to include in exec update (Thu).

6) 30/60 snapshot for priority workstreams- 30: complete facilitator procurement + run 2 follow-ups with pilot managers.
- 60: create repeatable facilitator packet + train an internal lead.
- 90: handoff playbook to Ops for quarterly rollout; metrics: manager satisfaction, ramp time for new managers.

7) Signals & metrics I’ll track (what I will report next 1:1)- % managers who adopt at least one coaching technique from pilot (target: 60% by next monthly check).
- # escalations related to team dynamics (target: down 20% vs baseline).
- Time-to-onboard metric for new hires (keep < 3 business days for hardware provisioning).

8) Quick decisions needed- Do we allow external facilitator for rollouts in this quarter (yes/no)? Needed by Tue EOD.
- Approve small reallocation of training budget ($4k) to secure facilitator (yes/no).

9) Risks I’m watching- Vendor clause could delay facilitator start by 2–3 weeks.
- Manager follow-ups could cascade into consulting requests; scope creep risk.

10) Notes to self (todo list / reminders)- Capture the 2 best behavioral anchors for the rubric and add to Confluence. (TODO)
- Add case study blurb to internal newsletter if pilot shows signal improvement. (TODO)
- Remind Legal to expedite clause review (ping Jon). (TODO)

11) Conversation script / 1:1 agenda (2–3 bullets to use in meeting)- 1. Quick wins: 90s each on pilot + rubric progress.
- 2. Top asks: budget and escalation approach (explicit ask + impact).
- 3. Two-minute risk readout and desired decisions with deadlines.

12) Reflection prompt (for career signal tracking)- What did I learn about influencing without authority this week? One sentence: I improved cross-functional traction by shipping a minimal artifact (rubric draft) that reduced debate friction — next: embed two examples in the interview guide to reduce cognitive load for interviewers.

OPEN ITEMS (short)
- Legal clause redline (assigned: Jon) — due Tue.
- Facilitator brief (assigned: Amelia) — due Wed.
- Follow-up 1:1 with manager who surfaced personal performance concern — schedule by Mon.

END.
